character.motivation: Wants to build a proper gate and prove he can keep a small flock together.
character.voice: Open, playful, short bursts of enthusiasm.
character.backstory: Kit grew up hearing adults call the old field empty. He learned from Willa that families had once kept gardens there and began sketching a new gate for a small flock.
character.quest_hook: Help Kit test a model gate, then ask the people who remember the field whether they want livestock there again.

dialogue.introduction: I told the lamb to stay here. I think it heard me and made a different plan.
dialogue.friendship: I told a lamb about school once. It ate the end of my homework. Best listener I've had.
dialogue.supper: Can we have supper outside again? I want to show Pip which end of the kite is supposed to go up.
dialogue.hearing: Does this mean we can use the old field? I know exactly where I'd put the first gate.
dialogue.favorite_gift: Can I take it out to the fence? Food tastes better when the lamb's looking at you.
dialogue.disliked_gift: I can't bring a fish home again. The lamb rolled on the last one.

routine.hobby: Walks the green before heading in
routine.home_context: Lives on the green side of the orchard neighborhood, within walking distance of the meadow flock.
